note: Large SRA (690-acre lake) near Lehigh; this is the non-equestrian Beach Campground (separate from the two equestrian campgrounds). Camp loop sits in an open clearing set back behind trees from the lake; the sandy beach is a separate day-use area. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
